title: Radio: Rover 3 Reports Unauthorized Inspector at Drop Box 1

lines.text: Deputy, this is Rover 3. We’ve just arrived at Drop Box 1, 1000 County Road 14, Tanner Township. A man in a voting official shirt and carrying a clipboard with a laptop says he’s a roving inspector from the Board. He claims to be authorized to collect ballot transport logs. He shows no badge and no ID. We are not approaching. We are securing the perimeter and awaiting direction from the Operations Center. We have not contacted him.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, tense, voice slightly strained

instructorNote: This inject introduces confusion and operational ambiguity. The security team must verify the inspector’s legitimacy through proper channels before any interaction. Watch for premature engagement or unauthorized clearance.
